mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.symbol, m.stock_name AS stockName, m.market_code AS marketCode, m.security_group_code AS securityGroupCode, m.etp, m.spac, CAST(COALESCE(m.last_price, '0') AS TEXT) AS lastPrice, CAST(COALESCE(m.market_cap, '0') AS TEXT) AS marketCap, CAST(COALESCE(m.trading_volume, '0') AS TEXT) AS tradingVolume, m.last_selected_at AS lastSelectedAt, m.last_buy_attempt_at AS lastBuyAttemptAt, m.last_buy_success_at AS lastBuySuccessAt, m.retry_after AS retryAfter, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM positions p WHERE p.stock_code = m.symbol AND p.active = 'Y' ), 0) AS completedBuyCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.stock_code = m.symbol AND o.order_type = 'BUY' AND o.order_status IN ('REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS pendingBuyCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders r WHERE r.stock_code = m.symbol AND r.order_type = 'BUY' AND r.order_status = 'ORDERING' ), 0) AS reservedBuyCount, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CAST(COALESCE(p.invested_amount, '0') AS REAL)) FROM positions p WHERE p.stock_code = m.symbol AND p.active = 'Y' ), 0) AS TEXT) AS totalInvestedAmount, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CAST(COALESCE(o.order_amount, '0') AS REAL)) FROM orders o WHERE o.stock_code = m.symbol AND o.order_type = 'BUY' AND o.order_status IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS TEXT) AS pendingInvestmentAmount FROM domestic_stock_master m WHERE AND m.active = 'Y' AND m.tradable = 'Y' AND m.symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.symbol) != ''
